findings.evidence: checks.R constructs svydesign from all positive finite-weight parent rows before subset(full,eligible), nest=TRUE, with lonely PSU set to fail; reported parent n=88062, domain n=9786, 133 strata, 271 nested PSUs and degf=138. Candidate/common design fields are matched by SEQN before fitting.
findings.limit: Pooled weights, parent design variables and cycle construction were reused; their derivation was not independently reconstructed.

findings.evidence: All coefficient and entire covariance transformations, SEs, coefficient CIs, signed Wald ratios, p values, fitted probabilities and linear predictors are checked with fixed tolerances. Recorded maximum probability error is 5.93969318174459e-15. Separate Q arithmetic confirms reported marker coefficients and SE scaling.
findings.limit: Full fitted objects/covariance matrices are not persisted, so the whole-covariance evidence consists of inspected assertions, final successful execution and recorded error maxima, not a Q independent refit.

findings.evidence: Raw-marker type-7 quartiles, right-closed intervals preserving ties, factor Q1 reference, unchanged domain/covariates and t(138) Wald CIs match plan. Twelve contrasts are present; all four category totals equal 9786. Q recomputation of ORs, CIs and p values agrees to below 1e-10.

Two log-scale internal knots, observed boundaries, rank-2 residual basis against (1,x), bidirectional span checks, full adjusted model rank check and Cholesky check of tested covariance are implemented. The saved transform evaluates plot grids, and full model-row differences compute reference covariance. Four tests use F=W/2, numerator df=2, denominator df=138. Q checked p values, Bonferroni/BH n=4, all curve CI arithmetic, exact OR=1/SE=0 at each reference, and RDS/JSON basis agreement. Plot visually inspected with readable labels.
findings.limit: Reported CIs are pointwise and conditional on sample-derived knots/reference; no simultaneous band or biological shape guarantee.

findings.evidence: All 21 recorded output hashes and all 8 source/input/approval hashes match at review time. Logs show attempt 1 and 3 exit success and attempt 2 assertion failure. Q independent CSV arithmetic checks passed; only locale startup warnings occurred in Q arithmetic execution.

findings.evidence: Spline failures have per-marker records, whereas unexpected log/quartile assertion failures stop the entire script before final summary CSVs. All four actual log/quartile checks succeeded, so no current result is missing.
findings.limit: This script is accepted for the submitted bounded run, not certified as a general failure-reporting framework for different future data.

approved_claims: On the frozen common operational candidate domain, ln/log10 fits are numerically equivalent after the declared coefficient/covariance rescaling; per-unit OR values differ by definition.
The submitted 12 survey-weighted quartile contrasts implement the declared unweighted raw type-7 grouping and Q1 reference with pointwise t(138) Wald CIs.
All four planned spline diagnostics are estimable and reject logit linearity at Bonferroni family alpha 0.05 within this fixed candidate-FI analysis; their maximum adjusted p is about 1.883e-5.
The curves are analyst diagnostics from the same spline models, relative to each marker median over its fixed 5th-95th percentile display range, with pointwise CIs.
Age-50 inclusion adds 806 rows in the full design derivative and 93 in the common operational domain; this does not identify the authors' unique code predicate.
limits: No certification of author-identical FI, original-paper replication, or causal inference.
No independent certification of existing marker generation, raw-source pooling weights, or upstream complete-case derivation.
Q reviewed code, saved outputs, logs, hashes and independently recomputed derived output arithmetic; Q did not independently refit the statistical models or reread raw source data.
Four-test multiplicity adjustment applies to nonlinearity diagnostics only; quartile CIs and p values are pointwise/unadjusted and must not be described as familywise corrected.
A significant spline diagnostic does not identify a threshold, prove causation, or validate a selected biological curve; it assesses the fixed working logit specification.
Marker formula arithmetic on the submitted derived columns is reconciled; raw-source marker provenance remains outside independent certification.
